title: ClassPromotion - a raise of one container's class (core v2 section 8.7)
description: Upward only: bare < light < heavy. Signed by two different parties, the issuer and the holder. A container that could quietly claim a higher class would be claiming anchors it never had, so the raise is a signed act and not a field the holder edits. The schema checks the shape; that `to` is above `from` and that `from` is the class the container holds now is checked by the verifier.

container.description: The container being raised: its identifier, not its serial.

signatures.description: At least two: the issuer's and the holder's.
